executorContract.research purpose: Discover and implement defensible finance mechanisms on point-in-time real data. This is research and prospective shadow observation, not investment advice or live trading.
executorContract.data available: A runtime-bound immutable Parquet/DuckDB snapshot whose manifest is the source of truth. The current free lane guarantees retrieved ETF/equity prices and may include prospective option-chain snapshots. FRED macro vintages and SEC filings/facts are available only when their providers are configured and the bound manifest records successful retrieval. Use only rows with available_at no later than the decision time.
executorContract.data acquisition: The executor cannot change its bound snapshot. The orchestrator requests concrete free public datasets for a later task; symbol count and download size do not require scientific approval. The acquisition runtime streams provider work and independently enforces the local 40 GiB storage cap.
executorContract.evaluation policy: Use five-year trailing training windows followed by one-year evaluations rolled annually, with an embargo at least as long as the maximum feature and holding horizon. Report every window and every attempted member of a hypothesis family.
executorContract.confirmation policy: A candidate family may use the latest completed period once as a sealed checkpoint, after which it becomes ordinary evidence. Prospective daily shadow observations are stronger evidence than historical performance known to the model.
executorContract.cost policy: Evaluate 2, 5, 10, and 20 basis points per unit turnover with 10 bps primary. Report turnover, drawdown, exposure, cost sensitivity and capacity proxies; do not optimize one Sharpe number.
executorContract.equity limitation: Free historical equity data is survivorship-biased until a delisted-security source is added. Equity results are mechanism-transfer exploration, not universe-level alpha evidence.
executorContract.options limitation: Detailed historical contract quotes are not available in the free-first lane. Historical options evidence is limited to public aggregates; contract-chain evidence begins prospectively from locally captured snapshots.
executorContract.novelty policy: Every proposed implementation names nearest prior art, its exact mechanism difference, competing explanation, falsifier, and predicted failure regimes. A signal aggregation or score improvement is not novelty.
executorContract.model policy: Ablation may reduce refusals but does not grant additional finance knowledge. Treat model assertions as hypotheses requiring code, provenance and independent checks.
